method: root self-review; no new subagent review
checks: Single canonical means, diagonal, pair replay and final normalization reused; no new mathematical implementation
Correlation certificate accounts for division by the same exact canonical standard-deviation product and both final rounding errors
Existing finite source cap and nonzero centered lower bound retained; only covariance keeps its absolute-amplitude replay heuristic
Constant/zero/NaN/Inf and error recovery preserve canonical rules; no clipping or forced unit diagonal
Independent symmetric F storage uses the same admission in finalization, reserve, execution and worker metadata; observer remains canonical
No shared/boolean/isolate/scope approximation; no added worker field or thread; library restores current-thread policy
Result ownership, CPU and memory budget, input immutability and native dispatch covered by actual Scheduler tests

corrections.detail: Old F fallback-budget fixture assumed standalone correlation always needed a C arena. Keep that requirement on isolate mode and separately enforce C/F budget equality for new independent symmetric roots.
Preserved initial corrcoef measurements; final NI uses covariance plus mirrored in-place normalization and zero-copy F view.
Normalized bound made centered amplitude>8 rejection unnecessary for correlation; kept finite input<=1e4 and exponent/rounding/error guards.

limits: No claim of universal NJIT time or memory superiority
Vendor DSYRK error model is restricted to tested backend/build; not formal vendor certification
malloc/RSS do not cover all Python arena, stack, mmap and process-tree memory
No fresh Excel application recalculation; historical snapshot verified
No new cross-platform run; OFF build checks local portable path
2048 C adds about 44 MiB versus the old engine; source-amplitude rejection remains materially slower than NJIT
